purpose: Evolve one creation through seven evidence-bearing parallel creative rounds, retain exactly two judged survivors after every round, run applicable UC self-tests before output, and finish with a deep-aftertouch evidence gate without auto-accepting or auto-canonizing either finalist.

properties.criteria: optional existing specialist-tournament weighted judging criteria
properties.pool_size: 8..40 specialist profiles used by each round tournament
properties.submissions: complete object keyed by every current round team_id
properties.judgements: complete independent existing tournament judgements keyed by team_id
properties.candidate: candidate or artifact body for a registered deterministic self-test adapter

contains: parallel context-specific creative-team packets from the existing specialist tournament
two exact evidence-bearing survivor outputs after every completed round
direct visual-thought and project verification self-test adapters
explicit NOT_TESTED state for unsupported evidence surfaces
two retained final outputs with structural, functional, visual, experience, context, adversarial and polish evidence lanes

relationships: composes the existing specialist tournament instead of creating a second parallel-team ontology
uses the existing deterministic simulation and project-verification surfaces when the artifact kind is supported
creative outputs and semantic judgements remain externally supplied evidence rather than faked deterministic cognition
the best two complete judged outputs remain live after each round and become explicit parents for the next round
deep aftertouch is a final evidence-bearing creation pass rather than a decorative label after generation
finalists are retained but never automatically accepted, merged, canonized, or called perfect
limitations: the chamber prepares creative-team packets but does not claim a team reasoned, built, rendered, played or tested until concrete executor evidence is supplied

v0.1 direct self-test adapters cover visual/Paintgun thought simulation and project/software/game project verification; other media remain NOT_TESTED until an adapter or external evidence provider is attached
independent tournament judgements are evidence inputs and can still be poor or biased; the chamber preserves their exact declared basis rather than treating the score as objective truth
seven rounds and two survivors are fixed v0.1 policy to preserve the requested creative evolution shape
all-PASS final evidence does not prove perfection, universal aesthetic quality, semantic correctness outside tested claims, or human acceptance
persistent_state: Chamber state, round history, survivor lineage and evidence are carried explicitly by the caller in v0.1; no hidden chat state is required.

truth.basis: Unsupported tests remain NOT_TESTED, complete independent judging is required before survivor selection, and final PASS is explicitly bounded to declared evidence lanes.

agency.basis: Two finalists remain available after the seventh round and neither becomes accepted or CANON automatically.

continuity.basis: Every survivor carries parent identity, candidate digest, team origin, evidence, unknowns and exact round lineage into the next state.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: The chamber deliberately spends seven bounded rounds on creation, simulation, observation, repair, stress and aftertouch before treating output as final-candidate material.
